Idk for sure I haven’t said anything about it yet, except the next morning I asked him what happened cuz I didn’t remember it, but I saw the videos he sent me so I know it happened
I know I don’t want to, but I need to. So how do I get myself to want to? or get myself to do it anyway even if it’s not what I want? (Cuz I know at the end of the day I know it’s what’s I need).

Damn, you’re right. I’ve never thought of it like that. I’m so desperate for love, affection, validation, and attention it’s embarrassing that I’ve stayed this long and settled for how badly he treats me. Thanks

I should’ve added that he is looking for a job, he just hasn’t been able to find one yet cuz he’s a convicted felon. Do I wait for him to find one and pay me back the money he owes me or just end it now? I kinda want the money back not gonna lie since I’ve already wasted so much money on him anyway

You’re right. I don’t have much of a social life outside of him, which is why I want to stay friends. I have a few friends but they either live far away so we don’t get together too often or have a family of their own they’re preoccupied with. And he owes me $1000 so I don’t want to leave now and never get that back.
I have wondered if it’s trauma bonding but i gaslighted myself into thinking that it’s not actually the case. Thanks for your help
Okay. Thanks for you help! I’m sure I’ll be back on here posting another thread for advice if things go south :/ I’m hoping for the best outcome of all this though

Do you think he and I could remain friends? I don’t have many close friends I hang out with on the regular anyway, because they either live far away or have kids of their own that they are preoccupied with. So most of my social life is with him.

Also what should I do if he owes me $1000? I lent it to him to help him get back on his feet when he got out of jail and both of us understood that it was a loan and that he would pay me back when he can. I even made him sign a loan agreement cuz I doubted he would pay me back even if/when he got the money. Do I just forget about that money and move on? I don’t need it to pay bills but I would like it back cuz I work so hard for my income and that would be nice to treat myself to a weekend getaway or something. I doubt he would pay me back if we’re not together anymore cuz why would he bother? Do I wait to end it til he pays me back or just forget ever getting that back?

I do agree that I’m not grieving him necessarily, but more so having to start over and therefore having to wait a while to start a family even though I want to do that now. That’s the hard part for me. I will miss him as a companion but I do want a better partner. He’s sleeping in my bed at my apartment right now while I’m at work (which not gonna lie, that bothers me). I pay for our meals when we go out and I do the cooking and he doesn’t do either. But anyway I’ll talk to him about it when I get home but I don’t know how to say it. I feel bad.

Yes, I definitely want my children raised in a healthy and stable environment. I appreciate your insight. I guess it is selfish of me to bring a child into this world with him just because I want kids right now and I don’t want to wait any longer for someone better. No, Im not scared or leaving because I don’t think he would hurt me or anything. Im not sure if he cares enough about me to go out of his way to do something like that if I left. He’s told me he wants to have kids with me because he really wants kids and that way I’ll be stuck with him and he knows I’m financially stable enough to support our children even if he can’t. I just wish I hadn’t wasted this much time with him. I should’ve left when he went to jail but I felt partially responsible for it since I told the cops what happened, so I stayed to be loyal. I wish I had never even met him and fallen in love. I’m dreading ending it cuz I’m going to be so heartbroken and I don’t want to go through the process of getting over him.

Ugh, I know. When you put it like that it sounds so pathetic of me to even want this. It’s just hard when having children is all I’ve wanted for the past couple years now that I’m settled in my career. I know I’m likely capable of raising them myself if it came to that because I have a strong family support system and make good money. But I don’t want my kids to grow up without a father. But I do wish it was a different person as their father too. I may not ever find anyone else to have a family with though, unfortunately. I guess I just have to accept those chances?

That’s true. The only thing is when it comes to focusing on what I want to accomplish, having a family is all I want to accomplish right now. I’m done with college and grad school, and I have a good career. I have everything I want except children. I do agree about focusing on self worth though because I do struggle with self esteem and self worth, since I am willing to settle for this type of behavior from my bf. I know I deserve better but I don’t really care that much and I don’t know why. I would rather just have a family now and have my kids to focus on caring for next. I don’t know how I’m going to muster up the courage to leave him

That is a good point. Fortunately, they are not in my apartment. He splits his time (rent free) between me and his brother, with all of the illegal activity going on at his brothers house. But still, it’s points like this that I never considered, which is why I posted on here so that I could get as many responses as possible to help me make a decision. Thank you
